agentmemory.description: Persistent memory for coding agents. Saves decisions, lessons and session history and recalls them in later sessions. Runs the @agentmemory/mcp stdio server, which calls a local agentmemory server at http://localhost:3111 (start it with `npx -y @agentmemory/agentmemory`; set AGENTMEMORY_URL to use another address). Memory is stored under ~/.agentmemory on your machine. Nothing is sent to a model provider unless you configure one.
